answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 67300 Country: India Title: Can interest money be used as accident compensation? Question: I met with a minor accident with a Muslim boy, he is injured a bit, but now asking for compensation of Rs. 1500/- for his medical expenses. I want to ask if I can give him that amount from interest earned from my bank account? Please reply soon. Answer ID: 67300 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1174/1242/L=11/1437) In the question mentioned above, it is not lawful for you to give him interest money as compensation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
